mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 900K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 900K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling a supply chain rebound, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling labor market stress, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the surprise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the ratio of retail sales (RSAFS) to GDP (GDPC1) provides a constant, real-time indicator of consumer demand strength, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the ratio is above its 3-month moving average.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS/GDPC1 > 3-month MA.
